infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wheela uses your location to find nearby drivers and show ride routes.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Wheela uses background location to track trips in progress.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Wheela requires background location access to support real-time trip tracking.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wheela uses your camera to capture profile photos, verify driver documents, and report incidents. Camera access is optional and only activated when you choose to take or upload a photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Wheela needs access to your photo library to upload profile photos and incident reports. Photo access is optional.

plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Wheela uses background location to track trips in progress and provide accurate ride updates.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Wheela uses your location to show nearby drivers and navigate to your destination.
